stories.headline: 'I've applied for more than 400 roles' - how young people are facing the job shortage
stories.summary: The BBC has been hearing from young people who are struggling to find work about how they are tackling the challenge.

voices.student_north: Bhai 400 applications? Rookie numbers. Humare batch mein toh ek ladka 800+ applications kar chuka hai. Aur kya mila? Ek rejection email jo itna polite tha ki lagta tha girlfriend breakup kar rahi ho. Ab toh woh LinkedIn pe "open to opportunities" likha hai — matlab ghar baithe depressed ho raha hai.
voices.student_south: Bhai 400 applications. I'm at 47 and already feeling like a rejected contestant on a reality show. Meanwhile our placement officer still thinks LinkedIn is a Facebook alternative. Job market ne humein sahi mein "apply karo aur disappear" mode mein daal diya.
voices.professional_north: Bhai 400 applications! Humara resume itna circulate ho gaya hai ki LinkedIn pe viral ho jayega. Aur phir jab finally kisi ne call kiya toh "sorry, position fill ho gaya." Mujhe laga HR wale ne apna WhatsApp status update karne mein busy hai.
voices.professional_south: Bhai 400 applications, zero callbacks — that's literally our office WhatsApp group right now. Even freshers applying like it's a lottery ticket. At least we have one job to stress about; they don't even have that luxury. Job market se zyada ruthless toh appraisal meeting hota hai.

stories.headline: Ten years of recovery: How a bankruptcy legislation turned India's banks around
stories.summary: The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code framework's biggest achievement has been shifting power from defaulting promoters to creditors, altering borrowing and lending behaviour across the system.

voices.student_north: Bankruptcy code strong ho gaya toh ab promoters default nahi kar sakte. Acha hai — matlab future mein jab hum apni startup khol lenge aur fail hogi, toh bank wale humko pakadenge instead of running away like those rich uncles. Bachpan se suna tha — "paisa kamao," ab samajh aaya — "paisa चुकाओ nahi toh jail.
voices.student_south: Bhai bankruptcy code ne defaulters ko maar diya, creditors ko power diya. Sounds good until you realize — tera startup idea fail ho gaya, bank loan liya, ab tere ghar ka fan bhi nahi bachega. Ten years recovery? Tu toh first year mein hi default ho jayega.
voices.professional_north: Yaar, finally ek aisa kanoon bana jo defaulters ko seedha pakda. Pehle toh promoter bhaag jaate the, bank ka paisa leke. Ab woh bhi shaking hain. Humara bonus toh abhi bhi phantom hai, lekin atleast ab bank waale bhi serious ho gaye hain EMI recover karne mein. Chhota sukoon hai.
voices.professional_south: Bankruptcy code ne defaulting promoters ka power cheen liya—accha hua. Ab humein bhi hope hai ki agar boss ka startup fail ho toh atleast humara pending salary recover ho jayega. Dusre ki default, humari salary—yehi toh Indian economy ka real recovery hai.

stories.summary: The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code completes a decade having resolved over 1,400 large corporate cases and helping halve gross bad loans in the banking system. The April 2026 amendments now usher in IBC 2.0.

voices.professional_south: Bhai, IBC 2.0 matlab ab aur companies collapse honge cleanly. Banking system ka bad loan badh raha hai, aur hum sab ka job security badh rahi hai — lekin opposite direction mein.
